[[File:Sprigatito9GemPackVol1.jpg|200px|thumb|Artwork by Shūhei Yasuda]] '''Shūhei Yasuda''' (Japanese: '''{{j|安田周平}}''' ''Yasuda Shūhei'') is a character designerhttps://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2019-10-11/new-pocket-monster-tv-anime-casts-kana-hanazawa-yuichi-nakamura/.152135, animation directorhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EqiEKk7txmY and key animator of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. Yasuda began working on the animated series as a key animator during {{aniseries|XY}}, with his first credit being for the ending animation of [[DreamDream]]. He was promoted to a character designer on {{aniseries|SM}}https://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/pokemon_sunmoon/staff/, then held the position of chief animation director for {{aniseries|JN}}. He also animation-directed the opening animations for the all versions of [[One, Two, Three]]. Additionally, Yasuda has contributed illustrations for the {{pkmn|Trading Card Game}}, exclusively for cards related to the animated series. There are {{PAGESINCATEGORY:Illus. by Yasuda Shuhei}} cards illustrated by Yasuda. For a list of cards he illustrated, go [[:Category:Illus. by Yasuda Shuhei|here]]. ==Confirmed cuts== This is a list of cuts confirmed to have animation by Yasuda.
